merge_order_finding.problem: PR #156 targets main while #157 and #158 target codex/Audit, so the three are not on one line.
merge_order_finding.consequence: #156 carries the 18 commits from main up to codex/Audit's baseline. Until it lands, main is behind the line the other two PRs sit on. Merging #157 or #158 first would advance codex/Audit and leave #156 needing a rebase.
recommended_order: 1. merge #156 into main, which brings main to the shared baseline
2. merge #157 into codex/Audit (or retarget it to main once #156 lands)
3. merge #158 after #157, because both touch apps/ArcheAxis.Desktop and the six UI contract tests, so the second one must be re-checked for conflicts rather than assumed clean
